design_context: SaaS Web App with Dashboard + Marketing Landing Page

rules: No generic fonts for headings. Use IBM Plex Sans for a technical, structured feel.
Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for agent logs, JSON outputs, and technical metadata.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase, text-xs, and tracking-[0.2em].
Use dark gray/zinc (#09090B) instead of pure black to avoid halation.
Keep text off-white or light gray for reduced visual strain.
Separate panels with 1px borders (border-white/10) rather than relying on shadows.

layouts.dashboard: High-density Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Panels use border-collapse style layouts.
layouts.live_run_view: Split-pane layout. Left pane: Interactive DAG graph (@xyflow/react). Right pane: Streaming logs in monospace font with minimal padding.
layouts.marketing_page: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical sections with generative webGL/particle backgrounds.
layouts.spacing: Use p-4 or p-6 inside dashboard panels. For marketing page, use p-12 to p-24 for luxurious spacing.

components.navigation: Left sidebar for dashboard (collapsible). Sticky glassmorphism header for marketing page (NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds).
components.status_pills: Small rounded-full indicators (e.g., green/amber/red dots) paired with monospace text.
components.cards_and_panels: Flat backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-white/10). No soft shadows on dark mode. Sharp or max 8px border-radius.
components.forms_and_inputs: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the technical dark theme.
components.dag_graph: Use @xyflow/react for the drag-and-drop workflow builder. Nodes should be flat, technical boxes with inputs/outputs.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on hover (-translate-y-1 for cards). Slight brightness increase for panel hovers.
motion.streaming_logs: Smooth auto-scroll for new log lines. Subtle pulse animation on active agent nodes.
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure hover states clearly change text/background color.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid borders (Technical look) exposing the skeleton. No full-screen generic gradients.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlays on marketing page backgrounds to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for marketing header (bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl). Never use over data/text.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use text shadow if placing text over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

images.description: Abstract blue glowing dots forming wave patterns
Server rack with blinking green lights

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React application (.js/.jsx files) following the 'Prometheus' dark theme.
Implement the landing page with high-impact typography, utilizing the provided background images.
Build a Dashboard shell with a left sidebar for navigation.
For the Run View, implement a split-pane layout: a React Flow DAG graph on the left, and real-time streaming logs on the right.
Use JetBrains Mono (or a similar monospace font) for agent logs and JSON outputs. Make them look like a terminal.
Integrate green/amber/red status pills into both the graph nodes and the log headers.
Use 1px borders and flat surfaces for panels. Avoid large soft shadows in dark mode.
Apply 'data-testid' attributes on all buttons, links, and forms.
Ensure all hover states explicitly set text and background colors.
NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for headers, dialogs or dropdowns.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Avoid simplistic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements and subtle border highlights.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `opacity` and `transform`.
Include hover states, transitions, and entrance animations for all interactive elements.
Avoid using emoji characters as icons. Use lucide-react instead.
Never use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided image URLs.
